posts.topic_title: Where can I get a good startup kit?
posts.author: tsgeoman
posts.post_subject: Where can I get a good startup kit?
posts.content_md: I have been interested in holograms for years and have decided to try to make my own. Can anyone recommend a really good startup kit complete with laser, plates, developer, mirrors, spliters, lenses. I need it all!!! THANKS

posts.topic_title: Where can I get a good startup kit?
posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.post_subject: Where can I get a good startup kit?
posts.content_md: Integraf has a simple kit for single beam work. To go past that you have to build your own. The guys at holography.ru talked about putting together a better kit but I don't know if they have succeeded.
